title: 第9章 再遇楚天骄豪夺炼气丹第10章 楚天骄的震撼
slug: 瞎婿第1754章总算找到你了
content_zh:
“天铭，刚才你是怎么看出那块原石里，有上古通灵宝玉的？”
回去的路上，韩清雪迫不及待的询问起来。
“运气。”
楚天铭笑着回道。
“哼，你少来，你真以为我是李斌那个蠢货么？这种敷衍的谎话，我根本不会相信！”
韩清雪没好气道。
楚天铭无奈解释道：“我的眼睛，能够看到一些常人看不到的东西，刚才我恰好看到那原石上有一些奇特的纹路，所以猜到里面可能会有宝物，但是我不知道会是一块上古通灵宝玉。”
“原来如此。”
韩清雪恍然大悟，随即看了眼楚天铭那苍白的双眸，惊奇道：“既然你的眼睛这么厉害，为什么你不刚才再开两块原石，说不定还能出一块宝玉呢，顺便正好教训一下李斌那个纨绔世子。”
楚天铭摇了摇头：“那样一来，会让我眼睛的秘密，暴露出来，所以不能太贪心，见好就收便是，反正这六百万两黄金足够我们这段时间使用了。”
“这倒也是。”
韩清雪凤眸眨了眨，道：“你打算用这些钱做什么？”
“先买一些炼气丹。”
“练气丹？那不是只有御气境的武者，才会使用的丹药么？你难道御气了？”
韩清雪讶然道。
“嗯。”
楚天铭点了点头，没有隐瞒。
闻言，韩清雪震惊的说不出话来。
要知道，几天前，楚天铭还是个被人遗弃的瞎子，可是这么短的时间内，他不仅恢复视力，而且还踏入了御气境界，这也太匪夷所思了吧！
“天铭……你是怎么做到的。”

“咳咳，不知道，就是练着练着便御气了。”
楚天铭不知道该怎么解释，便随口敷衍道。
“好吧。”
韩清雪见楚天铭不愿多说，也没有继续追问下去。
二人路过一处药行，便走了进去。
药行很大，里面有不少前来购买丹药的武者，且大部分都是年轻武者。
“你们看这不是那个瞎子么？他怎么跑到药行来了。”
“哼，大白天遇到这瞎子，真是晦气！”
楚天铭和韩清雪刚走入药行，便被人认了出来，立刻大厅内，响起了一阵阵讥讽嘲笑之声。
楚天铭装作没有听见，径直走到了柜台前，向着里面的药行掌柜说道：“我要买炼气丹。”
“炼气丹？”
那中年掌柜微微一怔，有些诧异的看着楚天铭，旁边的武者，也纷纷露出异样表情。
一个不能修炼的瞎子，跑到这里来买炼气丹？这家伙脑子没事吧？
楚天铭丢给他一个白眼：“那么吃惊做什么！
？你们药行不会连炼气丹都没有吧？”
中年掌柜干咳一声：“当然不是，只是这练气丹，乃是御气境武者才能使用，你一个瞎……您一个无法修炼之人，买来何用？”
“有什么用，就不劳你费心了，你将你们药行最好的炼气丹拿出来就是。”
content_en:
"Tian Ming, how did you tell that there was an ancient psychic jade in that rough stone just now?"
On the way back, Han Qingxue couldn't wait to ask.
"Luck."
Chu Tianming replied with a smile.
"Hmph, come on, don't come here. Do you really think I'm that idiot from Li Bin? I won't believe such perfunctory lies at all!"
Han Qingxue said angrily.
Chu Tianming explained helplessly: "My eyes can see some things that ordinary people can't see. I just happened to see some strange lines on the original stone, so I guessed that there might be a treasure inside, but I didn't know it would be an ancient psychic gem."
"That's it."
Han Qingxue suddenly realized, and then glanced at Chu Tianming's pale eyes, and said in surprise: "Since your eyes are so powerful, why didn't you just open two more rough stones, maybe you can also find a jade, and by the way, you can teach that dandy prince Li Bin a lesson."
Chu Tianming shook his head: "That would expose the secret of my eyes, so we can't be too greedy and just accept it when it's good. Anyway, these six million taels of gold are enough for us during this time."
"That's true."
Han Qingxue blinked and said, "What are you going to do with the money?"
"Buy some Qi Refining Pills first."
"Qi training pill? Isn't that a pill that only warriors in the Qi Control realm can use? Are you able to control Qi?"
Han Qingxue said in surprise.
"Yeah."
Chu Tianming nodded and did not hide anything.
Hearing this, Han Qingxue was shocked and speechless.
You know, a few days ago, Chu Tianming was an abandoned blind man, but in such a short period of time, he not only recovered his eyesight, but also entered the realm of air control. This is incredible!
"Tian Ming...how did you do it."
"Ahem, I don't know, I just get better at controlling Qi with practice."
Chu Tianming didn't know how to explain it, so he said casually.
"Okay."
Seeing that Chu Tianming was unwilling to say more, Han Qingxue did not continue to ask.
The two of them passed by a medicine store and walked in.
The medicine store is very large, and there are many warriors who come to buy elixirs, and most of them are young warriors.
"Do you think this is the blind man? Why did he come to the medicine store?"
"Humph, it's really unlucky to meet this blind man in broad daylight!"
As soon as Chu Tianming and Han Qingxue walked into the medicine shop, they were recognized, and immediately there were waves of ridicule and ridicule in the hall.
Chu Tianming pretended not to hear, walked straight to the counter, and said to the medicine shop owner inside: "I want to buy Qi Refining Pill."
"Qi Refining Pill?"
The middle-aged shopkeeper was slightly startled and looked at Chu Tianming in surprise. The warriors next to him also showed strange expressions.
A blind man who can't practice comes here to buy Qi Refining Pills? Is this guy okay with his mind?
Chu Tianming rolled his eyes at him: "Why are you so surprised!
? Your medicine shop doesn’t even have Qi Refining Pills, right? "
The middle-aged shopkeeper coughed dryly: "Of course not, it's just that this Qi Training Pill can only be used by Qi Control Realm warriors. You're blind...you're a person who can't practice. What's the use of buying it?"
"What's the use? I won't bother you. Just take out the best Qi Refining Pill from your medicine shop."
